doc.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021

chapter: Sun Ra's last years and the estate
title: Carrying Sun Ra upstairs after his stroke
summary: Gordon and his partner carried Sun Ra to his bedroom after the stroke and he saw him at the Village Vanguard.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Were you aware, I mean you must have been because of your business relationship when Sun Ra initially had a stroke and recovered to some degree and was able to perform a bit more, but were you in contact with him during that period?
Yeah I was. I remember with my business partner we had gone over there and we actually carried Sun Ra up the steps to his second floor.

He was in bad shape and he really had to be carried to the second floor where his bedroom was. I’m telling you people were really devoted to him. And I also saw him I think at the Village Vanguard right after his stroke. So yeah, Sun Ra was alive during all of this but it was bad. He couldn’t get around. You know how debilitating a stroke can be and it didn’t stop him from playing but it really limited his mobility.
